maj-06.exo: Love, attraction, important choices between alternatives. It points to relationships, alliances and decisions that call for deep involvement.
maj-06.psy: It represents the meeting of inner opposites and the moment of conscious choice; also the tension between reason and desire.
maj-06.ini: Path 17 from Binah to Tiphareth, the letter Zain (the sword, 7) and Gemini, the Air sign of Mercury: the sword that divides in order to make union possible. It is the beginning of the Chymical Marriage, the meeting of opposite principles that must in time fuse.
maj-06.sha: Ill-dignified, the Lovers signal indecision, infidelity, idealisation, or choices that divide a person against themselves.
maj-06.up: A choice must be made with heart and mind aligned; a meaningful union or alliance is possible.
maj-06.rev: Inner division, a conflict of values, unbalanced relationships, or a fear of choosing that leaves everything in suspense.
maj-06.love: Strong attraction and a meaningful bond; or a crossroads in love that calls for honesty.
maj-06.work: Partnerships and collaborations; decisions between two paths, to be weighed with analysis and integrity.
maj-06.spirit: The union of opposites as a path: first the analysis that distinguishes, then the synthesis that unites.
maj-06.crowley: Crowley makes it the first stage of the alchemical wedding: a black king and a white queen are joined by a hooded figure beneath a Cupid loosing his arrow, and the work begun here will be completed in Art (XIV).

maj-07.exo: Victory, advancement, mastery of the forces in play. It points to journeys, conquests and successes won through determination.
maj-07.psy: The ability to hold conflicting drives together and steer them toward a goal: the ego that puts on armour to protect a sensitive core.
maj-07.ini: Path 18 from Binah to Geburah, the letter Cheth (the enclosure, 8) and Cancer, the Water sign of the Moon in which Jupiter is exalted: the Mother sends her force toward Severity. The charioteer guards the Grail, the mystery of the Mother's blood.
maj-07.sha: Ill-dignified, it becomes aggression, a headlong rush, armour that isolates, an empty victory.
maj-07.up: Advance with decision: you have the strength to steer the situation. Protect what is sacred to you as you move.
maj-07.rev: A confused direction, inner forces at war, excessive defence or a stalemate; review the goal before you push.
maj-07.love: Protection and active commitment; or emotions locked behind armour that prevent intimacy.
maj-07.work: Progress, travel, competitions won through discipline and control.
maj-07.spirit: The Grail knight: guarding the inner cup while you cross the world.
maj-07.crowley: In the Thoth deck the charioteer holds no reins: he sits motionless, enclosed in amber armour, bearing the Holy Grail, while four elemental sphinxes draw the chariot on their own.

maj-08.exo: Justice, balance, legal matters and contracts. It shows that every action receives an exact, proportionate answer.
maj-08.psy: The ability to evaluate with clarity, recognising the consequences of your choices without guilt and without self-indulgence.
maj-08.ini: Path 22 from Geburah to Tiphareth, the letter Lamed (the ox-goad, 30) and Libra, the sign of Venus in which Saturn is exalted: the continuous adjustment that keeps the universe in balance. Every imbalance generates its own correction.
maj-08.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals cold judgement, legalism, partiality, or paralysis from over-deliberation.
maj-08.up: The situation tends toward rebalancing: honesty and measure lead to the right result. Official decisions or contracts are possible.
maj-08.rev: An unrecognised imbalance, harsh judgements of yourself or others, delayed outcomes; face reality squarely.
maj-08.love: A relationship seeking reciprocity; an exchange to be rebalanced with sincerity.
maj-08.work: Contracts, negotiations, legal matters; the outcome will be proportionate to what was sown.
maj-08.spirit: Accepting the law of cause and effect as a teacher, not as a punishment.
maj-08.crowley: Crowley renames Justice 'Adjustment' and swaps it with Lust, making it number VIII; he paints it as Maat, a masked dancer perfectly balanced on tiptoe, with the sword and the scales hanging from her headdress.

maj-09.exo: Withdrawal, reflection, prudence, the search for truth. It points to a period of introspection or to meeting a wise and discreet counsellor.
maj-09.psy: The need for silence in order to hear your own voice; the maturity that comes from experience worked through in solitude.
maj-09.ini: Path 20 from Chesed to Tiphareth, the letter Yod (the hand, 10), the seed from which all letters are born, and Virgo, mercurial earth: the secret of fertility hidden in matter. The inner light carried like a lantern into the world.
maj-09.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals isolation, closing off, emotional miserliness, a refusal of life.
maj-09.up: Withdraw to gain clarity: the answer comes from within or from a private guide. Act with prudence and method.
maj-09.rev: Solitude lived as flight or exile; or a fear of silence that scatters you among other people.
maj-09.love: A period of reflection; a need for personal space, bonds that ask for depth more than intensity.
maj-09.work: Study, research, specialisation; working independently and meticulously.
maj-09.spirit: The inner hermitage: guarding the seed of light that fertilises the world.
maj-09.crowley: Crowley's Hermit gazes at a lantern with the Sun at its centre, accompanied by a tamed Cerberus; the Orphic egg wrapped by the serpent, the field of wheat and the form of the spermatozoon allude to life transmitted in secret.

maj-10.exo: Changes of fortune, unforeseen events, turning points. Generally favourable, it shows that the wheel has begun to turn.
maj-10.psy: It shows your relationship with what you cannot control; it invites you to stay in the movement without clinging to either the high or the low.
maj-10.ini: Path 21 from Chesed to Netzach, the letter Kaph (the palm, 20) and Jupiter, the great benefic: the expansion that sets life in motion. The wheel turns, driven by the three qualities of nature, while at its motionless centre dwells Spirit.
maj-10.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals instability, chaotic chance, passive reliance on luck, sudden falls.
maj-10.up: A cycle changes: seize the opportunity. Expansion, good luck and new possibilities are on their way.
maj-10.rev: Resistance to change, or a sense of being at the mercy of events; the wheel turns anyway, so it is better to work with its motion.
maj-10.love: Sudden turns, meetings that feel destined; a relationship in a phase of transformation.
maj-10.work: Opportunities, expansion, strokes of luck; beware the volatility of earnings.
maj-10.spirit: Seeking the motionless centre of the wheel, where change cannot reach.
maj-10.crowley: On the ten-spoked wheel Crowley places Typhon, Hermanubis and the Sphinx, corresponding to the three gunas (tamas, rajas, sattva) and to the three alchemical principles, in perpetual alternation between lightning and stars.

maj-11.exo: Strength, courage, passion, vitality. It points to success achieved not by repressing the instincts but by riding them with enthusiasm.
maj-11.psy: The joy of your own life energy, accepted and integrated; the end of the inner war between spirit and instinct.
maj-11.ini: Path 19 from Chesed to Geburah, the letter Teth (the serpent, 9) and Leo, the house of the Sun: the horizontal path joining Mercy and Severity. Solar force, welcomed without fear, becomes creative ecstasy.
maj-11.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals excess, domination of the impulses, pride, a destructive use of force.
maj-11.up: Put passion and courage into what you do: your vitality is your main resource. A moment of creative strength and magnetism.
maj-11.rev: Energy that is repressed, or discharged without measure; fear of your own power, or its abuse.
maj-11.love: Intense passion, physical attraction, a vital relationship; avoid possessive dynamics.
maj-11.work: Bold initiatives, charisma, the ability to carry others along with enthusiasm.
maj-11.spirit: Ecstasy as a path: life force made holy instead of fought.
maj-11.crowley: Crowley replaces Strength with Lust, understood as joyful vigour rather than vice: Babalon rides the seven-headed Beast in ecstasy and raises the flaming Grail. The card takes the number XI, giving VIII to Adjustment.
